notes.title: The Steam Lunar New Year Sale
notes.content:
To celebrate the Steam Lunar New Year Sale, [i]Folkloric Excursion[/i] is [u]75%[/u] off!
Take this opportunity to learn about Brazilian folklore!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39207091/d4d9d58573ed63ce1f4c2699e433b728325e2762.png[/img]

Have fun while you defeat Brazilian folklore's creatures to learn about their legends! You have the power of [b]math[/b], don't be afraid to use it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39207091/5c33e1ba9c2477c9b057dce00deb8ff6bb9a40b3.gif[/img]

notes.title: Folkloric Excursion is now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39207091/5c33e1ba9c2477c9b057dce00deb8ff6bb9a40b3.gif[/img]

If you like math, you can check it out. If you do NOT like math, you [u]must[/u] check it out, because  [b]Folkloric Excursion[/b] was made for you!

I'm a solo indie developer and Folkloric Excursion is my first project. So, if you want to help to improve it, please give me feedback. You can use the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1389130/discussions/]discussions page[/url] or the [url=https://discord.gg/U6TrZZJUdW]Official Discord channel[/url] to report bugs or give suggestions.
There are some updates planned for the future, including Story mode, more localizations and some other things.

[hr][/hr]
Solve some operations, read some Brazilian myths and have fun!
I hope you guys like it!
